<onlyinclude><templatestyles src="Infobox_dlc_pack/styles.css" /><infobox theme="dlc-pack-infobox">
    <title source="name">
        <format><center>'''{{{name}}}'''</format>
    </title>
    <panel>
        <data source="platforms">
            <label>Platforms</label>
            <format>{{{platforms}}}</format>
        </data>
        <data source="steam_id">
            <label>Steam App ID</label>
            <format><code>{{{steam_id}}}</code></format>
        </data>
        <data source="skin_count">
            <label>Cosmetics</label>
            <format>{{{skin_count}}}</format>
        </data>
    </panel>
</infobox></onlyinclude>
==Documentation==
Infobox for a DLC pack page (e.g. Supporter Pack).
